name: Yumemiru Hiyoko
source:
A pure-hearted girl who lives in Ahiruno Town. She’s cheerful, but she’s also clumsy and not very athletic.

When she spotted Fumiya, the new transfer student, she took a liking to him as if he were her older brother.

Since he looked exactly like her cousin (who’s living overseas due to her parents’ circumstances), she calls him “Big Bro” and follows him around.

Lately, she’s been really worried that her two best friends have been acting a little distant toward her.
